properties.name: affinedrift-website
properties.sync_procedure: None needed — the public repo is the canonical source. Merge to main triggers the Quarto build and Pages deploy.
properties.notes: Quarto site. Apex domain affinedrift.com redirects to www; HTTPS certificate covers both.

properties.name: rate-of-closure-explorer
properties.sync_procedure: After a Tools merge touching src/rate_of_closure/web, run scripts/sync-from-tools.ps1 -ToolsPath <Tools checkout> in the mirror repo, review git status, commit, and push; the Pages workflow rebuilds and redeploys.
properties.notes: Canonical TypeScript model in Tools is pinned test-for-test against the Python implementation (parity governance: AffineDrift #3777). The mirror repo D-sorganization/rate-of-closure-explorer holds the deployable copy and the sync script.
